item.title: Coolest Thing Made IN Indiana Tournament Down To 32 Competitors
item.description: The Indiana Chamber’s fifth annual Coolest Thing Made IN Indiana tournament field has been trimmed from 49 to 32 competitors as first-round voting has concluded, and the second round tips off Dec. 5.

item.title: Warsaw Performing Arts Center Announces December Holiday Lineup
item.description: The holiday season is officially here, and the Warsaw Performing Arts Center welcomes the community to five festive events highlighting the talent of Warsaw Community Schools students.

item.title: Lilly Endowment Awards Goshen College $5 Million Faith, Storytelling Grant
item.description: Goshen College has been awarded a $5 million grant from Lilly Endowment Inc. through its National Storytelling Initiative on Christian Faith and Life 2025. The grant will support the college's launch of five innovative storytelling projects under the new media hub, More Than Just Stories.

item.title: The Center for Literacy & Learning Hosts Community Health Fair
item.description: The Center for Literacy & Learning at Grace College hosted an engaging health fair for students and their families in its tutoring program Thursday, Nov. 20.

item.title: Indianapolis Fitness Influencer Charged With Child Seduction
item.description: An Indianapolis fitness influencer has been charged with multiple felony counts of child seduction following an investigation involving a 16 year old girl - the influencer's stepdaughter, according to a social media post.

item.title: Meet Milford, L.I.T.E. Host Tree Lighting Ceremony
item.description: Meet Milford hosted its third Christmas tree lighting on the lawn of the Milford Town Hall Friday, Dec. 5.

item.title: Caucus set to fill Clay Township Trustee seat
item.description: Stephanie Stutzman, Clay Township Trustee, has announced her resignation effective Dec. 31, according to an announcement by Mike Ragan, chairman of the Kosciusko County Republican Central Committee.
